papers.title_en: Learning Waypoints and Passage Events for Decentralized Multi-Quadrotor Trajectory Planning
papers.authors: Yunhan Shi, Jia Deng, Zehao Jia, Lin Cheng, Shengping Gong
papers.evidence: 多四旋翼的分散式协同轨迹规划
papers.tldr: 多四旋翼穿越规划需在动力学与推力约束下协调空间路线和通过时序，联合优化困难。本文提出学习-优化框架，用网络预测空间路点与有序通过事件，并以公共物理时间网格对齐各机独立规划。方法将可微序列凸规划嵌入刚体动力学与旋翼推力约束，通过生成轨迹反向训练两个网络。两机24布局实验中，五个留出布局全部通过可行性与分离检查，平均完成指标较继承策略降低1.52%，交换布局中位前向时间21.01 ms。
papers.abstract_en: Multi-quadrotor passage planning requires coordinated spatial routes and passage times under vehicle dynamics and actuation constraints. Optimizing these decisions jointly couples temporal allocation, nonlinear motion, and inter-vehicle interactions, creating a computational challenge for local trajectory generation. We propose a learning-optimization framework that predicts spatial waypoints and ordered passage events for independently solved quadrotor planners. A common physical time grid aligns the vehicles, with intermediate events fixed by the networks and terminal progress optimized locally to permit different completion metrics. Differentiable sequential convex programming incorporates rigid-body dynamics and rotor-thrust bounds, allowing collision and completion gradients to train both networks through the generated trajectories. In a two-quadrotor evaluation across 24 layouts, the adapted policy passes physical feasibility and sampled separation checks in all five held-out layouts. Their mean completion metric decreases by 1.52% relative to the inherited policy. The median forward time is 21.01 ms on the held-out exchange layout with matching numerical trajectory references. These results demonstrate that learned spatial and event parameters can coordinate independent rigid-body planners while preserving local vehicle constraints in the evaluated scenarios.
